String.string:
[EN] Sibling Rivalry
[ES] Rivalidad fraternal
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Thank you."
[ES] "Gracias."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go to Rupeush at the Emergency Camp east of Pora Elinu.
[ES] Ve a ver a Rupeush en el campamento de emergencia al este de Pora Elinu.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'm ready."
[ES] "Estoy listo."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak with Porthea.
[ES] Habla con Porthea.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak with Rida and give her the hypnotic draught.
[ES] Habla con Rida y dale la poción hipnótica.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Her expression softens as the draught takes effect. Suddenly, her eyes flash and she glares at you!
[ES] Su expresión se suaviza cuando la poción hace efecto. ¡De repente, sus ojos brillan y te mira con furia!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Count on me."
[ES] Cuenta conmigo.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak with Princess Rida and convince her to make peace with Arin.
[ES] Habla con la princesa Rida y convéncela de hacer las paces con Arin.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Rhokasi's Heart
[ES] Corazón de Rhokasi
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Kill Rhokasi the Mad at the Bloodtalon Camp east of the Lake of Tears.
[ES] Mata a Rhokasi el Loco en el campamento Bloodtalon al este del Lago de las Lágrimas.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Bring Rhokasi's heart to Princess Rida in the Bloodtalon Camp.
[ES] Llévale el corazón de Rhokasi a la princesa Rida en el campamento Bloodtalon.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Very fair, Princess."
[ES] "Muy justo, princesa."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Okay."
[ES] "Está bien."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Bring Princess Rida's letter to Princess Arin of Pora Elinu.
[ES] Llévale la carta de la princesa Rida a la princesa Arin de Pora Elinu.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'll consider it."
[ES] "Lo pensaré."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Return to Pora Elinu and speak with Rida.
[ES] Regresa a Pora Elinu y habla con Rida.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Farewell, Princess."
[ES] "Adiós, princesa."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak with Princess Arin.
[ES] Habla con la princesa Arin.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'll do my best."
[ES] "Haré mi mejor esfuerzo."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak with Lienyn.
[ES] Habla con Lienyn.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
